notes: Speed/cost comparisons only use matched successful runs; all failures stay in success-rate denominators
Task-cluster bootstrap is exploratory for only 8 small synthetic tasks
API catalogue estimates include child usage; they are not OAuth subscription credit charges
Failed/incomplete assistant streams are excluded from complete-usage comparisons, even if every observed message included usage
Superseded batch results are preserved separately and not pooled with this corrected, frozen experiment.
Provider-error exclusion and all-task leave-one-out diagnostics were added after observing a provider retry; primary results retain every observation.
